IGUI_PhunZones_AddRectTooltip: Add a new rect at the current map centre for the selected zone
IGUI_PhunZones_FileTooltip: View contents of your lua/PhunZones.txt file
IGUI_PhunZones_UnsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes. Save them now?
IGUI_PhunZones_SayNoSafeHouse: You cannot create a safehouse in this area
IGUI_PhunZones_SayNoBuild: You cannot build in this area
IGUI_PhunZones_Title_Tooltip: Title of this zone that is displayed to the player
IGUI_PhunZones_Subtitle_tooltip: Optional subtitle that is displayed to the player
IGUI_PhunZones_Difficulty_tooltip: Zone difficulty level. Give your players an indication of the areas difficulty. Just a visual cue, not tied to functionality
IGUI_PhunZones_ModsRequired_tooltip: Mods that are required to be activated for this zone to be active. You can add multiple mods by separating each with a semi-colon. eg Bandits2;PhunZones
IGUI_PhunZones_PvP_tooltip: Overrides the PvP settings on the server for this zone. This will have no effect if PvP is disabled in your server settings
IGUI_PhunZones_Bandits_tooltip: If Bandits2 mod is installed and there are bandits in this zone, do nothing, move them out of the zone or remove them from game
IGUI_PhunZones_Zeds_tooltip: When a zed is in this zone: do nothing, move them out of the zone or remove them from game. Note that removing will include player corpses!
IGUI_PhunZones_NoWelcome_tooltip: True prevents the name of the zone on screen when the player enters
IGUI_PhunZones_Order_tooltip: Allows you to override an existing entry in the list. Just make this number higher than what you are wanting to override
IGUI_PhunZones_AllZones_tooltip: Tick to show everything in system - or untick to show just what zones are active
IGUI_PhunZones_NoSafehouse_tooltip: Explicitly forbid safehouse creation in zone
IGUI_PhunZones_NoBuilding_tooltip: Explicitly forbid building items like walls and such in zone
IGUI_PhunZones_NoPlacing_tooltip: Explicitly forbid placing items like TV's and suck in zone
IGUI_PhunZones_NoPickup_tooltip: Explicitly forbid picking up objects like TV here
IGUI_PhunZones_NoScrap_tooltip: Explicitly forbid scrapping objects (eg furniture) here
IGUI_PhunZones_NoDestruction_tooltip: Explicitly forbid using a sledgehammer or dissasembly in zone
IGUI_PhunZones_SayNoDestruction: You cannot destroy in this area
IGUI_PhunZones_NoFire_tooltip: Explicitly forbid fire from spreading in zone. Note that animations may show briefly, but will quickly fizzle out and no damage will occur
IGUI_PhunZones_NoPlayers_tooltip: Explicitly prevent players from entering this zone
IGUI_PhunZones_Field_Profile: Profile name; empty, none or default clears it
IGUI_PhunZones_Profile_Editing_tooltip: Which layer your property edits are written to. 'default' is the base configuration; anything else is a profile. Changing this does not change what players see - use Activate for that.
IGUI_PhunZones_Profile_Activate_tooltip: Make the selected layer live for all players
IGUI_PhunZones_Profile_DeleteConfirm: Delete profile '%s'? This cannot be undone.
IGUI_PhunZones_Profile_DeleteActive: It is live right now, so deleting it will revert players to the base configuration.
IGUI_PhunZones_Profile_BaseOnly: Only available on the base configuration. Switch Editing back to 'default'.
IGUI_PhunZones_Profile_SwitchUnsaved: You have unsaved changes to this layer. Save them before switching?
IGUI_PhunZones_Pvp_tooltip: Whether players can hurt each other here. Off makes this a safe zone. Leave it unset unless you mean it - as soon as any zone is set to on, everywhere else on the map becomes safe. Needs the server option PVP to be on, and applies to staff too: the check is on the tile, not the player
